import: import_pixel_character.gd extracts complete cels, removes transparent/key spill, resolves the enlarged authored pixel grid with nearest sampling, and registers whole drawings on 112x112 RGBA canvases. Native standing figure is 88 pixels tall at the same game-world height as v24. Source RGB values are retained; no palette substitution, desaturation, averaging or image blur.
identity: The newly authored idle head, face and upper hair are preserved byte-for-byte across the fixed-facing walk/departure clip. Each PNG is still one complete character, never a runtime limb rig.
timing: v24 phases and one/two-tick exposures are preserved exactly. 48 drawings over 63 display intervals; period 1.05 seconds. The departure endpoint reuses the actual walking cel and anchor.
rendering: Version 2 manifest describes native canvas size/scale and nearest sampling. The native sprite material passes texture RGB unchanged. Historical versions and the old coverage renderer remain available for comparison.
limits: Fine pixel appearance still needs user visual acceptance; passing functional checks is not aesthetic acceptance. Other facing/work directions in the full saved game are outside this opt-in preview.
